claim_and_offer_lease_transaction: job_attempts assigned->source_uploading, transition, gateway_job_offers, source transfer authorization
crash_before_send: durable offered row remains; reconnect redelivers before expiry, or expiry returns attempt to assigned
disconnect_after_send_before_accept: same recovery; delivery timestamp is diagnostic, acceptance is authoritative
accepted: gateway_job_offers accepted and existing job_service transitions persist
declined_temporary: attempt returns to assigned and can be offered again
declined_permanent: existing job lifecycle transitions attempt to failed
duplicate_execution_prevention: transport ownership plus authoritative attempt state
